contradicting_evidence: Settled ETF outflows, shrinking stablecoin supply and weak current participation provide a coherent downside risk cluster that could develop into a directional decline.
Improving short-window breadth and ETH's positive 24h return could instead become the start of a recovery if subsequently sustained.
The 90d altseason readings of 51 and 56 show some longer-window relative participation, but do not resolve the coming week's direction.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The packet does not support a reliable net up-or-down forecast over seven days. Recovery and renewed weakness both remain credible; NO_EDGE does not imply a flat market or low volatility. A durable direction requires evidence of persistence in price, relative strength, participation and flows that is not yet supplied.
falsification_conditions: A sustained joint improvement in BTC and ETH prices, ETH/BTC, broad participation and subsequent settled flows would resolve the current lack of edge toward UP.
Persistent price deterioration alongside weakening ETH/BTC, broader declines and continued liquidity or flow deterioration would resolve the lack of edge toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: No multi-session forward confirmation of ETF demand, spot demand or stablecoin deployment is available.
A settled BTC-dominance level of 60.1978% without a supplied comparable sequence cannot establish a rotation trend.
There is no supported catalyst schedule, cycle-transition date or complete lower-cap participation measure.
supporting_evidence: Current signals conflict across windows: ETH is positive over 24h but ETH/BTC declined in the completed hour, while breadth improved from the prior packet but remains weak in absolute participation.
The 30d altseason score is 43, versus 90d readings of 51 and 56; this does not establish a consistent short-window expansion.
One settled ETF session, limited intraday observations and modest supply contraction are insufficient to identify a persistent seven-day net direction.
The structural prior describes competing recovery and retest scenarios rather than a confirmed regime; it does not supply independent confirmation of either outcome.
